key_findings: Semaglutide dose-dependently reversed cyclophosphamide-induced motor and sensory deficits in rats.
It upregulated SIRT1/AMPK, restored PI3K/AKT/mTOR and Nrf2, and suppressed TNF-alpha and IL-6.
